about: Public features of each library crate that no gated comparison compares directly with its reference, by crate: each by a short stable name, the public items it is reached through, how near it comes to a direct comparison and what a comparison would need. `degree` is one of `step` (compared only as a step inside a larger compared operation), `recorded` (checked against reference output recorded once, which no worker re-runs), `outside-gate` (compared with the reference by an opt-in test or a command the gate does not run), `unit-tests` (unit tests only), `untested` (no tests) and `no-reference` (no reference implements it). A crate listed with no features was reviewed and has none; a crate not listed is not reviewed yet. A feature leaves its list when a gated comparison compares it directly. `cargo xtask check-design` checks the list and holds the count per crate to harness/gate-exceptions.json, so a feature left uncompared is recorded as visibly as a loosened gate.

triergon.name: play-pipeline
triergon.needs: a worker operation running examples/play/pipeline.rs over Matroska, MP4 and TS inputs, its packets, RGBA pictures and stereo PCM graded against the reference's demux and decode of the same file by the h264, hevc and audio lane rules; tests/play.rs checks counts only

triergon.name: any-reader-mpegts
triergon.needs: mpegts-access-units cases read through AnyReader::open and folded as that contract folds; no gated operation opens a transport stream through the facade

triergon.name: any-reader-seek-and-control
triergon.needs: seek and reset cases of matroska-cues-preroll, isobmff-seek and mpegts-previous-picture run through AnyReader and Blocking and folded as those contracts fold, with each packet's random-access flag

triergon.name: blocking-probe
triergon.needs: every Probe verdict (TS188 apart from M2TS192, ID3- and junk-prefixed elementary input) and the adapters' format choice and replayed prefix compared with the reference's av_probe_input_format3 and demuxer choice; compared today only through codecs-files reading the files they open

triergon-bitstream.name: cabac
triergon-bitstream.needs: H.264 and HEVC picture comparisons exercise every Engine method. The HEVC overrun check observes only the length of the slice returned by data(). A specification oracle needs to compare the returned slice and cursor values and cover initial offsets 510 and 511, bypass reads of 17 through 32 bins, and capped unary reads

triergon-bridge.name: text-subtitle-bridge
triergon-bridge.needs: bridge-text-subtitles compares container-to-cue playback. A comparison still needs to exercise TextBridge reset and the TextSource packet accessors.

triergon-bridge.name: bitmap-subtitle-bridges
triergon-bridge.needs: bridge-bitmap-subtitles compares container-to-picture playback. A comparison still needs to exercise Matroska DVB startup and live clock packets, bitmap receiver reset and the PGS packet-clock queue action.

triergon-bridge.name: legacy-aac-initialization
triergon-bridge.needs: matroska-legacy-aac's feed setup built through this function, its parameters folded against the reference's codec parameters; the gated feed derives them without calling it

triergon-bridge.name: compact-replay-prefix
triergon-bridge.needs: a coverage run showing matroska-audio-clocks executing feed_packet on every case with a buffered prefix, and startup cases whose buffered prefix holds video

triergon-capture.name: session-configuration
triergon-capture.needs: ARMv7 parity for the capture configuration cases, which compare configured GOP, rates, VBV and multiplex settings, including a matching refusal for a one-bit buffer on AArch64

triergon-codec-aac.name: inspection-aids
triergon-codec-aac.needs: none: per-frame statistics of the decoder's own state behind the inspect feature, which no reference reports

triergon-codec-ac3.name: decoder-options
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: The CRC and dither-free lanes compare these options. FFmpeg crccheck can emit a different number of frames, and exact dither-free AC-3 PCM and error-free strips still have open cases.

triergon-codec-ac3.name: decoder-modes
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: FFmpeg 9.0.2 has no option for the A/52 mode. Its decoder refuses reduced-rate E-AC-3 and does not expose the specification mode's strict dependent-substream and end-of-frame handling or dither generator.

triergon-codec-ac3.name: frame-info
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: The reference does not publish audio block tool flags. The ac3-features oracle compares complete version-8 AC-3 syncframes. Annex E syntax, other bitstream versions and truncated audio blocks need separate oracle coverage.

triergon-codec-ac3.name: bit-position-trace
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: The dither-stripped stream pins exercise the trace product. Exact AC-3 PCM and complete reference decoding of all stripped inputs remain open.

triergon-codec-flac.name: integer-output
triergon-codec-flac.needs: a gated comparison of native integer PCM, including the low bits of 32-bit samples. The test step verifies the integer output against STREAMINFO MD5. The codecs-files item grades decoded float PCM and stereo device output.

triergon-codec-flac.name: crc-policy
triergon-codec-flac.needs: The flac-crc-reject lane compares Reject with FFmpeg crccheck. Frame counts differ where the reference logs a damaged frame and still emits PCM.

triergon-codec-hevc.name: picture-properties
triergon-codec-hevc.needs: The frame reference exposes the three CICP values but no independent bit for presence of the description. The picture-properties contract compares the values, range, aspect ratio and visible planes.

triergon-codec-mpeg1.name: encoder
triergon-codec-mpeg1.needs: capture qualification compares construction and encoding at additional geometries, rates, VBV sizes and GOP lengths, including the refusal of an undersized VBV buffer. The budget-taking entry points need separate comparison

triergon-core.name: source-signatures
triergon-core.needs: media-probe compares the facade signature policy against the installed demuxer probe. The independent opening-box policies, competing transport spacings and exact Need lengths still need a direct comparison.

triergon-core.name: reader-protocol
triergon-core.needs: Push comparisons exercise request windows, Yield and Backpressure resume against the blocking rows. Coverage does not establish every ContainerReader, InputCursor, Blocking and Feed entry point or the full failure and reset domain.

triergon-elementary.name: seeking
triergon-elementary.needs: The elementary seek lanes compare the landing and packet suffix. Open cases retain different frame positions, clocks and damaged-stream recovery, including Xing and bitrate estimates.

triergon-elementary.name: stream-metadata
triergon-elementary.needs: elementary-metadata compares the demuxer view and elementary-metadata-wire compares the authored syntax and tag envelopes. Open cases retain distinct FLAC declarations, free-format refusal and tag dictionary results.

triergon-elementary.name: format-probe
triergon-elementary.needs: media-probe compares the elementary Kind over four prefix lengths. Open cases retain distinct demuxer scores and recognition policies for short prefixes and leading junk.

triergon-hls.name: unit-packet-views
triergon-hls.needs: the hls-segments and progressive-ts188 folds read through PacketInfo

triergon-hls.name: aac-segment-clocks
triergon-hls.needs: an hls-segments operation folding the resolved AAC clocks; the gated operation folds take_with_ns_clocks only

triergon-hls.name: standalone-access-unit-readers
triergon-hls.needs: hls-segments and progressive-ts188 cases fed through push_compact with each unit's source bytes folded; the gated readers run both types through push only

triergon-hls.name: segment-push-input-and-tails
triergon-hls.needs: hls-segments cases fed through provide in varied windows, folding the 90 kHz audio tail and each video unit's feed spans beside the existing fold

triergon-mpegts.name: transport-packets
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-packet-fields compares all carrier fields and ranges against the specification oracle. The ts-packets reference comparison still has opening refusals on physical entities the source framer reads.

triergon-mpegts.name: psi-catalogue
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-psi-readers compares the standalone PAT and PMT readers with the formats demuxer. Open cases cover table recovery, stream identity and private namespace selection.

triergon-mpegts.name: source-stream-polling
triergon-mpegts.needs: TransportStream driven through poll, poll_feed, poll_feed_carriers and poll_compact over the mpegts-pes corpus, every TraceEvent folded (PES raw PTS and DTS, source ranges, tables, timelines, diagnostics) against the reference's per-PID packets, each form required to fold as poll does

triergon-mpegts.name: pes-assembler
triergon-mpegts.needs: PesAssembler fed each PID's transport payloads at varied splits, folding header fields, raw times and source ranges against the reference's packets of that PID (pts, dts, pos, bytes)

triergon-mpegts.name: demux-observer-forms
triergon-mpegts.needs: mpegts-pes cases run through the unregistered constructor, the input-bound pushes and the compact payload cursor, folding every span's payload, source range and context against the same reference packets; compared today through the owned DemuxPacket form only

triergon-mpegts.name: fault-and-completion-facts
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-fault-facts compares raw headers, projected packet fields and the EOF consequences of the proof policies. Resolve its open differences in admission, physical boundaries and recovery.

triergon-mpegts.name: demux-clock-header-projections
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-recovery-trace compares the encoded-header and diagnostic-header clocks on emitted packets. Resolve its open recovery inputs before closing the comparison.

triergon-mpegts.name: demux-profile-metadata
triergon-mpegts.needs: a check that each profile's label, revision, operation and flags equal the reference worker identity the harness records for the contract that names it; nothing a consumer runs

triergon-mpegts.name: reader-views
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-reader-views compares track configuration and time bases, AC-3 syncframes, DVB segments and opaque ranges. Review the open differences in packet and track projections.

triergon-mpegts.name: continuity-reader-container-view
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-reader-container drives the ContainerReader implementation and compares packet output and residue evidence. Resolve the open damage and continuity cases.

triergon-mpegts.name: reference-trace-catalogue
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-catalogue compares the projection and its opt-in PSI policies with the formats demuxer. Open cases cover its selected-program scope, unsupported descriptors and stream types, disposition flags and table recovery.

triergon-mpegts.name: reference-trace-recovery
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-recovery-trace compares registered, selected-AVC, private-audio and DVB recovery. Combined faults, invalid timing prefixes and incomplete PES remain open.

triergon-mpegts.name: mux-single-program
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-mux-readback compares the emitted programs, streams, SDT names and PES packets. Open cases retain the difference between the transport random-access indicator and FFmpeg’s key flag, and invalid configurations that produce no TS to demux.

triergon-ogg.name: track-properties
triergon-ogg.needs: ogg-tracks compares identification, setup, comments, timing, configuration state and header errors. Open cases retain different end clocks, dictionary projections and malformed-header handling.

triergon-ogg.name: page-codec
triergon-ogg.needs: ogg-pages compares the parser and writer with the bitexact muxer and independent wire controls. Open cases retain three remux differences and a muxer refusal for Skeleton.

triergon-pixel.name: ycbcr-palette
triergon-pixel.needs: PGS and DVB folds cover Nearest with BT.601 and BT.709, and subtitle-dvd compares BT.601/HalfDown through MOV palette configuration. BT.709/HalfDown still needs a direct palette operation because no subtitle decoder or demuxer selects it.

triergon-playback.name: container-probe
triergon-playback.needs: a worker operation probing each corpus input at several prefix lengths and window sizes, folding the selected format and the replayed bytes against the reference's av_probe_input_format3 over the same prefix

triergon-playback.name: source-view-playback
triergon-playback.needs: worker operations playing each format through Player with the source clock and folding every packet's source times, flags and bytes against the reference's packets; the gated operations reach Engine::matroska and Engine::mp4 with demux clocks only

triergon-playback.name: demux-view-entry-points-outside-the-gated-operations
triergon-playback.needs: mp4-forward cases opened through compat::mov::index and index_encoded_range (the 499-row matrix is pinned FFprobe output no worker re-runs), and ts-program cases through open_segment, open_private_audio and the finite startup

triergon-playback.name: player-mp4-seeks
triergon-playback.needs: a seek operation on Player beside mp4-range's, folding the landing and following packets against the reference's av_seek_frame and av_read_frame; mp4-range seeks through Mp4RangePlayer::prepare_seek only

triergon-playback.name: catalogue-replacement
triergon-playback.needs: an operation that plays one file, replaces the catalogue with a second and folds the packets on both sides of the switch against the reference reading the first file to the same point and then opening the second; the reference has no transactional replacement

triergon-playback.name: fifo-delivery-and-pump
triergon-playback.needs: the playback corpus delivered through advance and pop and through Pump with a recording Sink, each required to fold the packets read_output folds against the same reference; the queue and sink protocol has no reference

triergon-playback.name: track-selection
triergon-playback.needs: cases selecting one track of each kind, folding only the delivered packets against the reference reading with AVDISCARD_ALL on the other streams; every gated operation selects all tracks

triergon-playback.name: neutral-views
triergon-playback.needs: the packet folds of mp4-forward, matroska-startup-seek and ts-program read through PacketInfo and TrackInfo instead of the format types, with each track's codec, tag, configuration and language against the reference's AVStream

triergon-raw-video.name: combined-probe
triergon-raw-video.needs: as playback's container-probe, with raw AVC and HEVC verdicts against the reference's h264 and hevc probe scores; raw-annex-b runs RawVideoProbe alone

triergon-raw-video.name: configuration-tracking-on-its-own
triergon-raw-video.needs: a README sentence naming raw-annex-b, hls-segments and matroska-startup-seek as the comparisons it runs inside, with a coverage run showing every public method reached; VUI timing beyond the picture period is folded by none

triergon-session.name: track-decoding
triergon-session.needs: Track construction and decoding are compared through codecs-files (including AAC MOV and Opus pre-skip across packets) and aac-access-units (fixed and program layouts). Reset PCM differences and session parity gaps remain in the codecs-sessions lanes.

triergon-session.name: audio-session
triergon-session.needs: The session lanes compare PCM, device output and block clocks. Damaged input, trim and drain timestamps, rate changes and reset behaviour have open parity cases.

triergon-session.name: video-session
triergon-session.needs: The session lanes compare RGBA output and reported timestamps. Unsupported profiles and an AVC mid-GOP reset remain open. Clocked video with defined input PTS still needs coverage.

triergon-shape.name: libass-rotations
triergon-shape.needs: ass-render compares character-first and advance-first rotation through image placement. A direct comparison is needed for GlyphRotations::get, len and is_empty and for an extent-first lookup, since rendering never queries the accessors or loads extents before the advance.
